t: Arrest Of Choung Siao-Mei - A Case Of Mistake In Identity

S. 2, Special Branch / slddhl -
REPORT
Date February 19, 35.
Subject Arrest of Choung Sieo-Mei (臧小梅) - a case of mistake in identity.
Made by S. S. Umemoto. Forwarded by 08k

At 7.30 a.m.. February 19, 1935, Sub-Inspector Fujii, Constables Soda and Yamaguchi of the local Japanese Consular Police called at S.S. Umemoto's quarters and requested assistance in executing a warrant of arrest against a Korean named Ren alias Ichi-He, on a charge of violation of the penal regulations for the control of explosives as well as murder and attempted murder. They also intimated that the matter had already been brought to the notice of Mr. Robertson, A.C.P.

D. S. Umemoto accompanied by the three officers proceeded to Central Station where the Sub-Inspector on Charge Room Duty was informed. Mr. Robertson was then communicated with by telephone and on his instructions the necessary assistance was provided the Japanese Consular Police to take the man to Central Station in the event of his arrest being effected.

A watch was then kept on Honan Road between Avenue Edward VII and Canton Road.

At 8.30 a.m. a man wearing a Chinese long gown who was walking north along Honan Road was pointed out to Sub-Inspector Fujii by a Korean agent as being the wanted man. He was accordingly arrested and taken to Central Station where he gave his name as Choung Sino-Mei (小梅), 29, Chinese clerk attached to the Traffic Office, S.M.P. and resident of No. 175 Jao Ka Feng, Siao Nan Lien, Nantao. This information was immediately reported to Mr. Robertson.

At the same time Mr. Fujii notified Mr. Hashizume, Chancellor of the Japanese Consulate, and asked him to call at the station. He arrived at Mr. Robertson's office at 9.20 a.m. After the clerk's identity had been proved to Mr. Hashizume's satisfaction he immediately acknowledged that a mistake had been made on the

S. 2，特别科 / slddhl -
报告
日期：1935年2月19日。
事由：逮捕臧小梅（Choung Sieo-Mei）——一起身份误认案件。
呈报人：S. S. 梅本（Umemoto）。转呈人：08k

1935年2月19日上午7时30分，当地日本领事馆警察局的藤井（Fujii）巡官、曾田（Soda）警员和山口（Yamaguchi）警员前往 S. S. 梅本的寓所，请求协助执行对一名名为 Ren、别名 Ichi-He 的朝鲜人的逮捕令，指控其违反爆炸物管制刑罚条例，以及犯有谋杀和谋杀未遂罪。他们还暗示，此事已提请助理警务处长罗伯逊（Robertson）先生注意。

D. S. 梅本随同这三名警官前往中央捕房，并向值班巡官室通报了情况。随后通过电话与罗伯逊先生取得联系，根据他的指示，为日本领事馆警察提供了必要的协助，以便在该人被捕后将其带往中央捕房。

随后，对在爱德华七世大道（Avenue Edward VII）与广东路之间的河南路进行了监视。

上午8时30分，一名身穿中式长衫、沿河南路向北行走的男子被一名朝鲜线人指认为通缉犯，并指给藤井巡官看。该男子随即被捕并被带往中央捕房，他自报姓名为 Choung Sino-Mei（小梅），29岁，系上海公共租界工部局警务处交通科的华籍职员，居住于南市小南门赵家丰175号。此信息立即报告给了罗伯逊先生。

与此同时，藤井先生通知了日本领事馆副领事桥爪（Hashizume）先生，并请他前往捕房。他于上午9时20分抵达罗伯逊先生的办公室。在该职员的身份得到桥爪先生满意的确证后，他立即承认在
